description: Source code for generating and handling native function schemas, variants, and kernels in PyTorch's codegen system.

classes.name: NativeFunction
classes.description: Represents a native function schema with associated metadata and variants.

classes.name: NativeFunctionsGroup
classes.description: A group of related native functions, including functional, inplace, mutable, and out variants.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema describing a function's arguments, return types, and other properties.

classes.name: DispatcherSignature
classes.description: Represents the signature of a dispatcher function.

classes.name: Expr
classes.description: Represents an expression in codegen context.

methods.name: pre_group_native_functions
methods.description: Groups native functions by their schema signature and kind.

methods.name: get_expected_out_variant_overload_name
methods.description: Returns the overload name for an out= variant based on a base name.

methods.name: self_to_out_signature
methods.description: Generates an out= schema from an inplace schema.

methods.name: functional_to_out_signature
methods.description: Generates an out= schema from a functional schema.

methods.name: generate_out_args_from_schema
methods.description: Creates out arguments and updates return annotations for out= schemas.

methods.name: mutable_to_out_signature
methods.description: Generates an out= schema from a mutable schema.

methods.name: generate_function
methods.description: Creates a new NativeFunction with a specified SchemaKind (functional or out) from an existing one.

methods.name: add_generated_native_functions
methods.description: Adds auto-generated native functions to the list, grouping and creating variants as needed.

methods.name: return_str
methods.description: Constructs a return statement string from return types and variable names.

methods.name: gather_nonaliased_inner_rets
methods.description: Gathers return variable names that are not aliased.

methods.name: gen_composite_functional_kernel
methods.description: Generates a functional kernel in terms of its inplace/mutable counterpart.

methods.name: gen_composite_out_kernel
methods.description: Generates an out= kernel in terms of its functional counterpart.
